title: calobota obovata
intro: Calobota obovata, commonly known as the "marum palm", is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Calobota obovata include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-anxiety effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
